_note: Intermission menu labels (bank 54 overlay tile atlas). A label is a strip of 8x8 tiles: block columns 'from'..'to' over block rows 'row'..'row+1' (16 px tall). The Korean text is rendered into the whole strip and every tile in it is rewritten.
_why_strip: Per-character 2x2 cells do not work. The Japanese characters are 16 px wide but are not placed on the 8 px tile grid - 作戦 for instance spans five block columns for two characters - so no pair of columns covers one character and a per-character rewrite always leaves a sliver of the original glyph on one side. Treating the label as one strip sidesteps alignment entirely.
_safety: Every tile in a strip must be resolved by out/title_menu_capture/intermission_overlay_resolved.json, must match the native capture, and must be a pure overlay glyph tile (mostly transparent, at most the label's two colours). A strip containing plate artwork is rejected whole rather than half-written.

labels._skip: MS is Latin and reads the same in Korean; left untouched.

_wipe: After drawing, the label ink in the surrounding one-tile ring is cleared, because the Japanese glyphs are not aligned to the tile grid in either axis and leave slivers outside the strip. Set 'wipe' to false where a neighbouring label shares the strip border: 開発 sits directly under MS, and wiping its ring eats the S.
